description: A set of pink-and-white strands tied at the top lies on the yellow bedspread in front of you. The left hand steadies the left strand near the base while the right hand repeatedly picks up the right-hand strands, crosses them over the center, and lays them down, tightening and straightening the developing braid by pulling outward and then returning to the middle; both hands alternate between holding and releasing the strands as the braid lengthens upward from the split.
